claims.text: Under s.6(6), a landlord cannot demand advance rent exceeding three months from an individual.
Demanding or receiving a premium on a tenancy is unlawful under s.6(4).
By s.11, the landlord is responsible for structural and external repairs.
A yearly tenant is entitled to half a year notice under s.15(1)(d).

threads.text: Did your Cross River landlord ask for one year upfront? Under s.6(6), an individual cannot be asked to pay more than three months advance rent. How many months did you pay?
threads.evening: In Cross River, asking an individual tenant for one year rent upfront breaches s.6(6). The legal limit is three months.
